marks.gloss_en: there ('the earth He gave to mankind') -- after the blessing
R' Chanina bar Pappa: whoever benefits from this world without a blessing is as if he robbed the Holy One and the community of Israel
R' Chanina bar Pappa: 'the companion of a destroyer' -- he is a companion of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who corrupted Israel before their Father in Heaven
אלמא משחא זיין -- since the vow 'whatever nourishes' leaves only water and salt permitted, oil is among what nourishes
אלא: חמרא סעיד, ומשחא לא סעיד -- wine satisfies, oil does not (= p_chamra_saeid; survives the difficulties of 35b.18-20)
וחמרא מי סעיד? והא רבא הוה שתי חמרא כל מעלי יומא דפסחא כי היכי דנגרריה ללביה -- wine whets the appetite rather than satisfying
טובא גריר, פורתא סעיד -- much whets, a little satisfies
evidently, oil nourishes
והרי שמן, דאשתני לעילויא ולא אשתני לברכה -- oil too changed for the better, yet its blessing did not change
entertained: [wine has its own blessing] because it changed for the better, therefore its blessing changed
והרי שמן, דאשתני לעילויא ולא אשתני לברכה -- olive oil too changed for the better, yet its blessing did not change: over it one still says borei pri haetz (answered at 35b.14, beyond this unit)
אמרי: התם משום דלא אפשר -- oil kept its blessing only because no fitting formula exists (= p_hatam_lo_efshar; refuted at 35b.15 by ונבריך עליה בורא פרי עץ זית and displaced by אלא)
there [oil kept its blessing] because it is impossible [to change it]: how would we bless? 'who creates the fruit of the olive'? -- the fruit itself is called olive
אלא אמר מר זוטרא: חמרא זיין, משחא לא זיין -- wine nourishes, oil does not (= p_mar_zutra_zayin; refuted at 35b.16-18, אלמא משחא זיין, and displaced by אלא)
ונבריך עליה בורא פרי עץ זית! -- a fitting formula does exist, 'who creates the fruit of the olive tree', so impossibility is not the reason
Mar Zutra: [oil changed for the better yet kept its blessing, unlike wine, because] wine nourishes and oil does not nourish

ומשחא לא זיין? והתנן: הנודר מן המזון מותר במים ובמלח -- everything but water and salt is called food; and on Rav Huna's okimta (the vow was 'whatever nourishes') it follows: אלמא משחא זיין (35b.18). Unanswered: the stam moves to a further answer with אלא
the mishnah: one who vows [to abstain] from food is permitted water and salt
נימא תיהוי תיובתא דרב ושמואל -- if everything but water and salt is 'food', then 'food' is not confined to the five species
באומר כל הזן עלי -- the vow was 'whatever nourishes', which is wider than 'food' (= p_rav_huna_kol_hazan)
Rav and Shmuel: one blesses 'who creates kinds of food' only over the five species alone
ומי סעיד כלל? והכתיב ...ולחם לבב אנוש יסעד -- bread is what satisfies, wine does not (a verse; no ObjectionKind names one)
אלא, חמרא אית ביה תרתי: סעיד ומשמח; נהמא מסעד סעיד, שמוחי לא משמח -- wine both satisfies and gladdens; bread only satisfies, so the verse assigns bread satisfying and wine gladdening
it is written: 'wine gladdens the heart of man ... and bread sustains man's heart' (Ps 104:15) -- bread is what satisfies; wine does not satisfy
אי הכי נבריך עליה שלש ברכות! -- if wine satisfies, let the three blessings [after a meal] be said over it
לא קבעי אינשי סעודתייהו עלויה -- people do not make their meal on it (= p_lo_kavei_inshei)
people do not make their meal on it [so the three blessings after a meal are not said over wine]
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak to Rava: if one made his meal on it, what [is the law]?
דאמר רבי ינאי: אין הטבל מתחייב במעשר עד שיראה פני הבית -- so produce brought in over roofs and through courtyards escapes the obligation
שנאמר בערתי הקדש מן הבית
the earlier generations would bring their produce in by way of the main gate
שנאמר ואכלו בשעריך ושבעו
R' Yochanan: even a courtyard fixes [produce for tithes]
the earlier generations made their Torah fixed and their work occasional, and both endured in their hands
דתניא: השותה שמן של תרומה משלם את הקרן ואינו משלם את החומש; הסך... משלם את הקרן ומשלם את החומש
אוזוקי מזיק ליה -- drunk plain it harms him (p_shemen_mazik), דתניא: one who drinks teruma oil pays the principal and not the fifth (p_baraita_shemen_teruma)
over olive oil one blesses 'who creates the fruit of the tree'
אי הכי, הויא ליה פת עיקר והוא טפל, ותנן: כל שהוא עיקר ועמו טפלה מברך על העיקר ופוטר את הטפלה (p_mishnah_ikar_tafel)
proposed: the dictum speaks of one who eats the oil with bread
תלמוד לומר ואספת דגנך -- הנהג בהן מנהג דרך ארץ

R' Yishmael: conduct yourself with [the words of Torah] in the way of the world -- not, as one might have thought from 'this book of the Torah shall not depart from your mouth' (Josh 1:8), literally as written
שנאמר ועמדו זרים ורעו צאנכם
שנאמר ואספת דגנך
שנאמר ועבדת את אויבך
R' Shimon ben Yochai: when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent, their work is done by others
R' Chanina bar Pappa set against each other: 'I will take back My grain in its time' (Hos 2:11) and 'you shall gather your grain' (Deut 11:14)
here ('you shall gather your grain') -- when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent
Abaye: many acted in accordance with R' Yishmael, and it went well for them
Rava to the Rabbanan: I beg you, in the days of Nisan and the days of Tishrei do not appear before me
